summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode with Tuple[ControlType, str]; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatter entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) gated only on is_terminal, returning True when written and False otherwise; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) for the new control type; CHANGELOG.md gets an Added heading above Fixed with a bullet linking PR 2200; tests added in test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing was run: tests, mypy, and black were not executed per instructions, and no commit was made. One docstring line in console.py may exceed 88 characters.
